versions.subject: New Trickbot wermgr rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\wermgr.exe'
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\rundll32.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
        - 'DllRegisterServer'
condition: selection
